text:
niko_pm: Short thread  recruiting 3 design partners for a compact pilot that mixes edge-routing resilience + int8 quantization profiles. Goal: validate that quantized models on Dedicated maintain quality within 10% of hosted baseline and that our edge routing + fallback preserves correctness. Need shortlist by Fri.

ravi_eng: I'll own the quant profiles and a tiny smoke test that compares logits / top-k between quant and fp16 on 20 sample prompts. ETA Wed. Will include a simple script to reproduce delta.

lina_ops: Ops note: network options vary; some customers require a hosted-edge appliance. I'll prepare a 1-page matrix: Peering | VPN | Hosted-edge + enable time. Also list firewall steps.

maria_research: Acceptance metrics (short):
- Quality: automated quality delta <= 10% on semantic similarity + task-specific extraction accuracy
- Perf: p95 latency improvement >= 10% with quant on Dedicated (if not worse than hosted)
- Reliability: fallback success >= 99% (fallback preserves correctness)
- Onboarding: <= 3 dev-days to run the quickstart and validate metrics
We'll include a 12-prompt canonical set (convo, extraction, code).

niko_pm: Screening q's draft: ```
1) Avg QPS and typical sequence length?
2) Can you accept quantized model variants for evaluation?
3) KMS vendor + rotation policy?
4) Preferred network option (peering / VPN / hosted-edge)?
5) Internal approver for pilot go/no-go?
6) One sample prompt + expected answer?
``` Add anything else?

ravi_eng: Add: "Can you run a small local comparison job (we'll provide script) and share the top-3 diffs?" Quickstart curl to trigger routing + quant path:```
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-quant-alpha","prompt":"Compare summarization quality","timeout_ms":1200}'
``` This will return route info in headers and a small quality hash in JSON.

lina_ops: Pre-Dedicated checklist (short): IP allowlist, VPN creds or peering details, KMS test key, on-call contact, signed DP MOU. I'll paste template.

nda-bot: Use "Design Partner" NDA v2026-07-05: https://redwood.docs/nda-dp. :white_check_mark:

maria_research: Eval plan: 12 prompts, nightly CI runner comparing quant vs fp16 on semantic sim and exact-match extraction. Partners can run locally or allow our runner on canned set. We'll require one real prompt sample up-front.

niko_pm: Incentive: $6k credits + 8 weeks priority Dedicated + 2 office-hour sessions from infra. Will mention possible co-marketing. Owners: @ravi_eng quant + quickstart, @lina_ops infra + runbook, @maria_research metrics + prompts, @niko_pm outreach. Shortlist Fri EOD, invites Mon.

ravi_eng: I'll post the repo + small reproduce script when ready.

lina_ops: I'll upload the infra matrix and rollback playbook (auto-split to hosted 75/25 on p95 breach >10m).

maria_research: Success to expand: 2/3 partners meet quality delta <=10% and integration <=72h and no security blockers. If not, iterate on quant profiles / routing.

niko_pm: Thanks everyone. Keep updates small and tag the shared spreadsheet when you take ownership.
